Label: City
Description: A city location.

Label: State
Description: A state or province.

Label: Country
Description: A country.

Label: County
Description: A county. Declared in the schema but not populated in the current release.

Label: Business Description
Description: Description of a business organization.

Label: Certificate
Description: A certification document. Not instantiated directly: nodes are typed with one of its 45 subclasses (e.g., sud:AerospaceQualityCertificate); list them from the types of sud:hasCertificate objects.

Label: Email Address
Description: An email address.

Label: Web Address
Description: A web address (URL).

Label: US Postal Code
Description: A United States postal code. Declared in the schema but not populated in the current release.

Label: Two Dimensional Cartesian Spatial Coordinate Datum
Description: A two-dimensional spatial coordinate. Declared in the schema but not populated in the current release.

Label: NAICS Classifier
Description: North American Industry Classification System classifier. Not instantiated directly: nodes are typed with one of its 77 subclasses (e.g., sud:NAICS111); list them from the types of sud:hasPrimaryNAICSClassifier objects.

Label: Product Category Classifier
Description: Classifier for product categories. Not instantiated: its 120 subclasses are used directly as product category nodes, the objects of sud:classifiedByProductCategory.

Label: Ownership Status Classifier
Description: Classifier for business ownership status. Not instantiated directly: nodes are typed with one of its 7 subclasses (e.g., sud:DisabledVeteranOwned); list them from the types of sud:hasOwnershipStatusClassifier objects.

Label: Special Business Status Classifier
Description: Classifier for special business status (e.g. minority-owned).

Label: Classifier
Description: A classification entity. Not instantiated directly: nodes are typed with its subclasses (e.g., sud:DisabledVeteranOwned).

Label: Manufacturing Process Capability
Description: A capability related to manufacturing processes. Not instantiated directly: nodes are typed with one of its 491 subclasses (e.g., sud:CNCMachiningCapability); list them from the types of sud:hasProcessCapability objects.

Label: Material Processing Capability
Description: A capability to process materials. Not instantiated directly: nodes are typed with one of its 120 subclasses (e.g., sud:AluminumProcessingCapability); list them from the types of sud:hasMaterialCapability objects.

Label: Quality Management Capability
Description: A capability related to quality management. Declared in the schema but not populated in the current release.

Label: Machining Capability
Description: A capability to perform machining operations.

Label: Casting Capability
Description: A capability to perform casting operations.

Label: Coating Capability
Description: A capability to perform coating operations.

Label: Fabricating Capability
Description: A capability to fabricate materials.

Label: Forming Capability
Description: A capability to form materials.

Label: Joining Capability
Description: A capability to join materials.

Label: CNC Machining Capability
Description: A capability to perform CNC machining.

Label: Additive Manufacturing Capability
Description: A capability for additive manufacturing (3D printing).

Label: Aluminum Processing Capability
Description: A capability to process aluminum.

Label: Steel Processing Capability
Description: A capability to process steel.

Label: Stainless Steel Processing Capability
Description: A capability to process stainless steel.

Label: Plastic Processing Capability
Description: A capability to process plastics.

Label: Copper Processing Capability
Description: A capability to process copper.

Label: ISO9001 Certificate
Description: ISO 9001 quality management certification.

Label: AS9100 Certificate
Description: AS9100 aerospace quality management certification.

Label: ITAR Certificate
Description: International Traffic in Arms Regulations compliance certification.

Label: Aerospace Industry
Description: The aerospace industry.

Label: Automotive Industry
Description: The automotive industry.

Label: Defense Industry
Description: The defense industry.

Label: Medical Devices Industry
Description: The medical devices industry.

Label: Semiconductor Industry
Description: The semiconductor industry.

Label: Minority Owned
Description: Minority-owned business status.

Label: Women Owned
Description: Women-owned business status. Declared in the schema but not populated in the current release.

Label: Veteran Owned
Description: Veteran-owned business status.

Label: Small Disadvantaged Business
Description: Small disadvantaged business status.

Label: Manufacturer
Description: A manufacturer in the supply chain.

Label: Organization
Description: An organization. Declared in the schema but not populated in the current release.

Label: Material Product
Description: A material product.

Label: Capability
Description: A capability of an organization or system. Declared in the schema but not populated in the current release.

Label: IOF Geospatial Location
Description: A location defined by geographic coordinates (IOF). Only 225 legacy nodes use it, reached from a SUDOKN geospatial site and carrying latitude and longitude values.

Label: IOF Geospatial Site
Description: A physical site with geographic location. Not instantiated directly: nodes are typed with its subclasses (e.g., sud:GeospatialSite).

Label: Industry
Description: An industry sector. Not instantiated directly: nodes are typed with one of its 59 subclasses (e.g., sud:AerospaceIndustry); list them from the types of sud:suppliesToIndustry objects.

Label: Geospatial Location
Description: A manufacturer's location: carries the street address, postal code, telephone and fax number, links to its city, state and country, and has a point geometry. Also typed geo:Feature and schema:Place.

Label: Geospatial Site
Description: A site of an organization in the older location model (227 nodes): links to its city, state and country and to an IOF geospatial location with latitude and longitude.

Label: Virtual Location Identifier
Description: An email address or web address of an organization; every sud:EmailAddress and sud:WebAddress node also has this type.

Label: Feature
Description: A discrete spatial phenomenon in a universe of discourse (GeoSPARQL). Every SUDOKN geospatial location has this type.

Label: Geometry
Description: A coherent set of direct positions in space (GeoSPARQL); here the point geometry of a geospatial location, read through geo:asWKT.

Label: Place
Description: Entities that have a somewhat fixed, physical extension (schema.org). Every SUDOKN geospatial location has this type.

Label: attests to
Description: Links a certificate to the capability it attests to. Declared in the schema but not populated in the current release.

Label: classified by product category
Description: Links a material product to its product category. The object is a product category class IRI used as a node (e.g., sud:TelevisionsProductCategory), not an instance.

Label: has business description
Description: Links a manufacturer to its business description node, whose text is read through hasTextValue.

Label: has certificate
Description: Links a manufacturer to a certificate it holds (e.g., ISO 9001, AS9100, ITAR).

Label: has email address
Description: Links a manufacturer to an email address node.

Label: has geospatial location
Description: Links a geospatial site of the older location model to its IOF geospatial location, which carries latitude and longitude.

Label: has management capability
Description: Links an organization to a quality management capability. Declared in the schema but not populated in the current release.

Label: has material capability
Description: Links a manufacturer to a material it can process; the capability node is typed with a material capability class such as sud:AluminumProcessingCapability.

Label: has NAICS classifier
Description: Links an organization to a NAICS classifier; the data uses its sub-properties hasPrimaryNAICSClassifier and hasSecondaryNAICSClassifier. Declared in the schema but not populated in the current release.

Label: has ownership status classifier
Description: Links a manufacturer to an ownership status such as minority-owned or veteran-owned.

Label: has primary NAICS classifier
Description: Links a manufacturer to its primary NAICS industry code (e.g., sud:NAICS332).

Label: has process capability
Description: Links a manufacturer to a manufacturing process it offers; the capability node is typed with a process capability class such as sud:CNCMachiningCapability.

Label: has secondary NAICS classifier
Description: Links a manufacturer to a secondary NAICS industry code.

Label: has special business status classifier
Description: Links an organization to a special business status. Declared in the schema but not populated in the current release.

Label: has web address
Description: Links a manufacturer to its web address node.

Label: located in city
Description: Relationship between a geospatial location or site and the city it is located in.

Label: located in city
Description: Relationship between a geospatial location or site and the city it is located in.

Label: located in country
Description: Relationship between a geospatial location or site and the country it is located in.

Label: located in country
Description: Relationship between a geospatial location or site and the country it is located in.

Label: located in county
Description: Relationship between a geospatial site and a county when the site is located in the county. Declared in the schema but not populated in the current release.

Label: located in state
Description: Relationship between a geospatial location or site and the state it is located in.

Label: located in state
Description: Relationship between a geospatial location or site and the state it is located in.

Label: manufactures
Description: Links a manufacturer to a material product it makes.

Label: supplies to industry
Description: Links a manufacturer to an industry it supplies (e.g., sud:AerospaceIndustry).

Label: organization located in

Label: organization located in
Description: Relationship connecting an organization to its geospatial location. Nearly all manufacturers point to a geospatial location; 227 use the older geospatial site.

Label: has geometry
Description: Links a geospatial location to its point geometry.

Description: The value of a virtual location identifier (email or web address).

Description: Number of employees in the organization.
